table.title: Process, preceding LSASS access and artifact

search.query: index=blue_team sourcetype=bt:public_sysmon validation_run="1794718921720366719" earliest=0 | fields _raw | spath | eval process_guid=lower(coalesce(SourceProcessGUID,ProcessGuid)), endpoint=lower(Hostname), event_time=strptime(UtcTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N") | eventstats min(eval(if(EventID=1,event_time,null()))) as process_start values(eval(if(EventID=1,RecordNumber,null()))) as process_records by endpoint process_guid | eventstats min(eval(if(EventID=11 AND like(lower(TargetFilename),"%lsass.dmp"),event_time,null()))) as artifact_time by endpoint process_guid | eval qualifying_access=if(EventID=10 AND like(lower(TargetImage),"%lsass.exe") AND event_time>=process_start AND event_time<=artifact_time,1,0) | eventstats min(eval(if(qualifying_access=1,event_time,null()))) as first_access values(eval(if(qualifying_access=1,RecordNumber,null()))) as access_records by endpoint process_guid | where EventID=11 AND like(lower(TargetFilename),"%lsass.dmp") AND event_time>=first_access AND isnotnull(process_start) | table Hostname process_guid process_records access_records RecordNumber TargetFilename UtcTime | table Hostname process_records RecordNumber TargetFilename
